text: This candidate for the Senior Full Stack Software Developer position received an overall fit score of 0.2361. The strongest evidence of their qualifications includes experience with "REST API", "Node.js", and "Docker". Key gaps include missing requirements for ruby, reactjs, sql, git, ci/cd, and cloud computing, as well as having less than the preferred years of experience. Despite the low fit and missing must-have skills, this application has been escalated for further review.
